title: Create responsive columns
summary: Ionic's grid uses rows and columns. A column can use a different share of the row at a wider breakpoint.
introduction: Ionic's grid uses rows and columns. A column can use a different share of the row at a wider breakpoint. Your task: Resize the browser and watch the column layout.
learningObjectives: Resize the browser and watch the column layout.
Explain the example for create responsive columns

blocks.text: Ionic's grid uses rows and columns. A column can use a different share of the row at a wider breakpoint.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.code:
import {IonApp,IonPage,IonHeader,IonToolbar,IonTitle,IonContent,IonGrid,IonRow,IonCol} from "@ionic/react";
export default function App(){return <IonApp><IonPage><IonHeader><IonToolbar><IonTitle>Reading club</IonTitle></IonToolbar></IonHeader><IonContent className="ion-padding"><IonGrid><IonRow><IonCol size="12" sizeMd="6">Stories</IonCol><IonCol size="12" sizeMd="6">Science</IonCol></IonRow></IonGrid></IonContent></IonPage></IonApp>;}
blocks.title: Create responsive columns

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `sizeMd` selects a column share from the medium breakpoint upward; the unprefixed size is the base choice.
`IonContent` owns the Ionic screen's scrolling content area. It works inside the starter app's page structure.

blocks.text: The columns stack on narrow screens and share a row from the md breakpoint.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The sizes are parts of a 12-column system, not pixel widths.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Resize the browser and watch the column layout.
